# netskope_aig_ai_provider (Data Source)

Manages a custom AI provider in the Netskope AI Gateway. Custom providers allow AIG appliances to proxy traffic to on-premise or private AI backends using OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude schemas.

Only custom providers (name starts with `cust-`) can be created/updated/deleted. Predefined providers are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_ai_provider" "my_aigaiprovider" {
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the AI provider.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Hostname of the AI backend.
- `name` (String) Name of the AI provider.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the AI backend.
- `protocol` (String) Connection protocol to the AI backend.
- `schema` (String) AI API schema the provider exposes.
- `type` (String) Provider type. Always "custom" for user-managed providers.
